title: The Golf Feedback Loop Podcast by Total Golf Trainer
author: Total Golf Trainer
description:
Welcome to The Golf Feedback Loop Podcast by Total Golf Trainer where golf instruction, coaching, training, technology, practice and performance come together to help golfers better understand how real improvement actually happens.

Golfers have access to more information than ever before. YouTube tips. Swing videos. Launch monitors. Social media instruction. Training aids. AI swing analysis. Tour-player breakdowns. Yet for many golfers, more information hasn’t necessarily led to better golf.

That’s where the feedback loop begins.

Hosted by the team behind  Total Golf Trainer, the podcast brings together experienced coaches, golf-industry professionals, competitive players, special guests and some of the most interesting minds in the game to have honest conversations about golf improvement, swing instruction, player development, practice habits, training aids, golf technology and performance.

You’ll hear from Michael Gish, owner and inventor of Total Golf Trainer, Fernando Vega, part owner and Head of Media & Marketing, and coach Drew Steckel, along with future guests from across professional golf, coaching, athletics and the golf industry.

The goal isn’t to give you another random swing tip.

It’s to help you better understand the process behind improvement.

We explore questions golfers and coaches deal with every day:

How do you turn a lesson into something you can actually practice?

How do you bridge the gap between what a coach tells you and what your body actually does?

What’s the difference between what a golf swing feels like and what is really happening?

How can feedback create better awareness?

When does technology help — and when does it simply create more information?

Why do so many golfers jump from one swing thought to another without making lasting changes?

What separates great golf coaching from simply reading numbers off a launch monitor?

How should golfers practice when their coach isn’t standing beside them?

And how can training become more structured, measurable and repeatable?

The Golf Feedback Loop goes beyond traditional golf instruction.

We talk PGA Tour and professional golf, elite coaching, amateur improvement, golf swing mechanics, practice systems, player psychology, training aids, launch-monitor technology, golf schools, junior golf, Tour stories, golf media, AI, modern instruction and the changing future of coaching.

Because the lesson is only the beginning.

Most importantly, expect conversations designed to turn information into understanding, understanding into training, and training into performance.

If you’re tired of chasing the next quick fix and ready to better understand your own process, you’re in the right place.

Welcome to The Golf Feedback Loop.

Better Feedback. Better Practice. Better Golf.

Subscribe to the channel and join us for new episodes, golf instruction, coaching conversations, Total Golf Trainer demonstrations, player interviews, Golf School content and more.

Learn more about Total Golf Trainer:
TotalGolfTrainer.com

title: Technomind Brainwaves
author: yipobo
description: Sounds for expanding consciousness, heightening awareness, creating positive results using brainwave technology Brainwave Entrainment refers to the brain's electrical response to rhythmic sensory stimulation, such as pulses of sound or light. When the brain is presented with a rhythmic stimulus like drums or light pulses, the rhythm is reflected in the brain. If the rhythm becomes consistent enough, it can start to resemble the natural internal rhythms of the brain, called brainwaves. When this happens, the brain responds by synchronizing its own electric cycles to the same rhythm.

description:

They discuss the recent party conferences and Burnham’s and Badenoch’s surprising popularity. David traces Britain’s deep-rooted problems back decades, from globalisation and China to the Iraq war and the 2008 crash, which he says is why there have been seven prime ministers in ten years. The longest section is on the upcoming Budget: how little room there is to manoeuvre, a flawed Budget process, the Treasury’s grip on policy, and the triple lock and welfare debates. title: The Zodiac Killer
author: Akbar
description: The Killer Who Turned Murder Into a Puzzle is a three-part true-crime podcast exploring the chilling case of the Zodiac Killer, one of the most notorious unidentified serial killers in American criminal history. Operating primarily in Northern California during the late 1960s, the killer targeted unsuspecting victims, sent threatening letters to newspapers, and challenged authorities to decipher cryptic messages that appeared to contain clues about his identity.This series examines the crimes, the investigation, the coded communications, and the public fascination that transformed the case into a lasting mystery. From the attacks that terrified communities around the San Francisco Bay Area to the infamous ciphers that captured national attention, each episode reveals another layer of a case filled with fear, uncertainty, and unanswered questions.The podcast also explores how the killer used newspapers and public attention to amplify his reputation, why investigators struggled to identify him, and how modern technology continues to inspire new attempts to solve the mystery.Separating documented facts from speculation, this series takes listeners through the evidence, the suspects, and the theories surrounding the case. More than a story about an unidentified killer, it is an examination of an investigation that continues to challenge the boundary between evidence and obsession.

title: Our Story
author: Fifth Word Theatre
description:
Commissioned as creative responses to the oral histories shared through an intergenerational participation project, Our Story features a set of new plays by award-winning and acclaimed playwrights Chris Bush, Jo Clifford, Lettie Precious, Luke Skilbeck and Mika Onyx Johnson. The writers hail from Nottinghamshire and beyond, and live in Nottingham, Derbyshire and across the UK. 

The podcast is the culmination of an intergenerational participation project, working alongside a group of young LGBTQ+ people and their allies from Mansfield and the surrounding area, who undertook a series of skills workshops. Young people used their newly developed skills to interview adult, trans and gender-diverse people of all ages, across Nottinghamshire, capturing their personal lived experiences and stories of identity, moments of resistance as well as joy and community. 

The plays have been directed by Jo Tyabji and with sound design by Louis Blatherwick and Joseff Harris.

Welcome to The Unspoken Motherhood, a podcast about the conversations that too often go unheard.
I’m Grace — a wife, a mother, and a woman with a story of my own.
Through personal experiences, candid conversations, and the voices of other women, we’ll explore pregnancy and infant loss, grief, maternal mental health, motherhood expectations, healing, and the difficult subjects society often avoids.
This isn’t about having all the answers. It’s about breaking the silence, challenging expectations, and creating a space where women feel heard, understood, and less alone.

Each episode features thoughtful conversations with professionals who are committed to learning, evolving, and improving how they lead, work, and show up for others. Whether you lead a team, serve clients, drive results, or simply want to keep growing, this podcast is designed to spark ideas, expand perspective, and help you move forward with greater intention.

title: The Dark Side of Entrepreneurship
author: Falak
description:
What happens when the dream of becoming your own boss turns into a life you can barely control?

Entrepreneurship is often sold as the ultimate path to freedom, financial independence, and personal success. Social media celebrates luxury offices, expensive cars, overnight success stories, and founders who supposedly never give up. But behind those carefully edited stories lies a side of entrepreneurship that rarely receives the same attention.

Beyond the Hustle explores the uncomfortable realities of building a business. From the loneliness of making decisions nobody else understands to the fear of losing money, the pressure to maintain a successful image, and the exhaustion of working without knowing whether your efforts will pay off, this series takes listeners beyond the motivational speeches.

Across three compelling episodes, we examine the emotional cost of chasing a dream, the financial traps that can turn success into stress, and the dangerous belief that working harder is always the answer.

This is not a podcast designed to discourage ambition. It is a reminder that ambition needs balance, realistic expectations, and a sustainable plan.

If you are an aspiring entrepreneur, a business owner, or simply curious about what happens behind the scenes of success, this series will challenge what you think you know about entrepreneurship.

Because building a business should not mean losing yourself in the process.

Join us in the Comleroy Tavern for our cinematic Dungeons & Dragons podcast set in a dystopian therapeutic utopia, where mystery unfolds slowly, truths are buried carefully, and every choice echoes through memory itself.

In the city of Callan, peace was not found — it was engineered.

Perched atop a marble escarpment, the Kirkbride Institute promises clarity, purpose, and emotional harmony. Through guided reflection, therapeutic programmes, and the Ten Tenets, its citizens are taught that every struggle has meaning… and every misalignment can be corrected.

Memories can be rewritten. Identity can be refined. And anyone, with enough dedication, can become an Exemplar.

But beneath the calm language of wellness lies something far more controlled.

This is a story of a society that doesn’t punish — it corrects.
A system that doesn’t command — it convinces.
And a city where the most dangerous thing you can lose… is yourself.

description:

Each episode lands on the anniversary of the day it happened: the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, the night Martians "landed" on the radio, the pilot shot down over Cuba, the men and women who built, defended and changed this country. Some stories you half remember from school. Most, you never heard at all.
Hosted by Ed Parcaut, a Navy veteran who believes the best stories in American history are the ones most of us never learned, and that fewer kids are hearing them at all. Every episode is researched from primary and trusted sources, listed in the show notes, so you can dig deeper. It's good listening for the drive to work, and for parents and kids who want to learn history together.

title: After Dark with Christine
author: CMPWritesBooks
description: Welcome to After Dark with Christine, a cozy, conversational podcast where everyday life, creativity, memories, strange stories, family traditions, writing, and a little bit of the unexpected all come together. I’m Christine, author and founder of CMPWritesBooks, and I’m inviting you along for the ride as I write, publish, build my business, develop new creative projects, and share the stories and experiences that inspire me along the way. But I don’t want this journey to be one-sided. I want to hear from you, too. Through emails, listener stories, questions, memories, and conversations, I hope this becomes a place where we can share a little of our lives with one another.Some nights we may talk about writing and where story ideas come from. Other nights it might be holidays, childhood memories, spooky legends, family traditions, creative adventures, or simply something that’s been on my mind. A little bit of this. A little bit of that. A little CMPWritesBooks — and plenty of real life in between. So settle in, get comfortable, and come along for the ride. Let’s get the conversation started.

title: Those Dudes Again ”Epsidoe 1:  How We Spent Our Summer Vacation”
author: Those Dudes Again
description:
Tampa Bay radio veterans Greg Wolf, Kevin “Stiffy” Cummings, and Ed “Special Ed” Grube are back with another episode of Those Dudes Again — and their summer stories do NOT disappoint.
  • World Cup Hosting: Greg took the stage to host the World Cup.
  • Career Chaos: Kev managed to get himself fired.
  • Cruise Control: Ed came dangerously close to earning a LIFETIME BAN from a Disney Cruise.
Three dudes. Three very different summers. Absolutely no shortage of chaos. From sports and pop culture to the completely unexpected, you never know where these conversations are going.
Like, comment, and subscribe for more Those Dudes Again, streaming on RHStv!
#ThoseDudesAgain #TampaBay #Vodcast #SportsTalk #comedy #RadioVeterans

title: Energy Therapy in Real Time
author: energytherapytime
description:
Join Michela (from Village Psychotherapy) and Carleigh (from Entera Kinesiology) as they perform an Energy Therapy Session in Real Time. 

Energy Therapy in Real Time is a podcast where we explore human transformation as it unfolds — live and unscripted. Through real sessions blending kinesiology, psychotherapy, Human Design and energy work, we create space to uncover subconscious patterns, shift old beliefs and explore the deeper layers influencing our lives.

This podcast is an invitation to witness what becomes possible when people are deeply seen, heard and supported.

title: Horror Chronicles
author: Alex "Killer Kiels The Horror King" Kielar
description:
Horror Chronicles, brought to you by Killer Kiels: The Horror King, is a deep‑dive journey through the entire history of horror cinema. Host Alex Kielar explores every era, from early silent trick films to modern nightmares. He breaks down each movie, tracing how the genre evolved, and ranking every film along the way. A mix of film history, analysis, and storytelling, this podcast uncovers how horror grew from simple illusions into one of cinema’s most creative and enduring genres. Follow the show from French filmmaker Georges Méliès' early films to present
https://linktr.ee/HorrorChronicles

title: Tides Watch
author: officialtideswatch
description: If you love the Halifax Tides as much as we do, you will want to tune in. We talk about every match, every player and every roster move. Join us for some fun and let's go Tides!!

title: Zero 260: Car Culture Podcast
author: Zero 260 Media with Mike Rob and AL P
description: Zero 260 Podcast simplifies the automotive world. This podcast is for those curious about cars but not necessarily experts. Bringing you to the level of an experienced car enthusiast. In each episode, we share what we find new in the automotive world. After the episode, we leave you with book recommendations we enjoyed or are thinking about listening to while we drive. We truly believe in raising the level of consciousness. Why not turn your daily ride to work into your Highway University!

title: VIBE Okanagan
author: VIBE Okanagan
description:
The VIBE Okanagan Podcast brings you the people, stories, ideas and experiences that make the Okanagan one of the most incredible places to live, work, visit and explore.

From local entrepreneurs, artists, chefs, winemakers and creators to community leaders, candidates and the characters who shape life in the Valley, each episode goes beyond the usual tourism story.

Hosted by Ray Brown, CEO and Editor-in-Chief of VIBE Okanagan, the podcast explores the people behind the places, the stories behind the businesses, the conversations shaping our communities, and the VIBE behind the Okanagan.

Whether you live here, are planning your next visit, or simply love discovering great people and great stories, this is the Okanagan, through a different lens.

When you set up the show, Apple and Spotify will also ask for a category. Society & Culture fits best, with Places & Travel as the second.

title: Lifted Imagination Podcast
author: Billy Champion
description:
Lifted Imagination Podcast (LIP), is the children’s storybook podcast made to be enjoyed with the physical book in front of you. 
Join me, Billy Champion, your reading buddy, for a warm, funny and naturally performed story-time; that keeps the words clear and the story front and centre. 
Follow-along with the words, look at the illustrations, and turn the pages with me.
This podcast is for you whether you can read or you're still learning. 
Find what our next storybook will be at listentolip.com or through the podcast emails before the title is live.
Join me for new stories weekdays.

description: Welcome to the F1 for dummies pod- F1 explained like your fave group chat gossip!

description:
Created by ANIMATION CONTENT CREATORS to support ANIMATION CONTENT CREATORS.
https://www.theanimationplatform.com/
Spotlighting Indie animation creators that are looking to promote their projects and talk about them! 
The Animation Platform (TAP) is here to share resources and connect animation content creators to the YouTube audience through collections of content. We are building library of collections to promote creators through blocks of content (shorts collections, development sizzles, web series etc). 
Please join our channel, subscribe and help spread the word.

title: Animal Power Showdown
author: Animal Power Showdown
description:
Real animals. Secret superpowers. In every episode of Animal Power Showdown, five real animals step onto the stage to show off an amazing power: sharks that sense hidden electricity, dinosaurs with spiky crowns, sea creatures that change color in a flash. Made for curious kids ages 6 to 10, and the grown-ups listening along. Every episode ends with a "Your Turn" question to talk about together.
Animal facts come from science organizations such as Oceana and the American Museum of Natural History.

title: The Power of Where Podcast
author: The Power of Where
description:
For decades, marketing fundamentals have been about the 4Ps: product, price, promotion and perhaps the most often overlooked: place.
The Power of Where is a future focused podcast exploring how place shapes perception, emotion, behaviour and growth, hosted by Blackjet CEO Robert Galletta.
From hospitality and retail to entertainment and travel, environments build trust, create belonging, influence decisions and turn experiences into lasting memories.
Each episode examines where culture is moving, where consumers are heading and how brands can use place as a strategic advantage to drive value.

title: The American Upside
author: Andrew Hines
description: We are both self made multi millionaires who "did it" in Canada. We made it! But we quickly realized the juice wasn't worth the squeeze to stay in Canada. 54% taxes, high regulations slowing us down and an economy that's just failing! We decided to restart our real estate investing business in the USA and build something incredible. We're going big! Bigger than we've ever done in Canada, and it's really paying off! We're now flipping many properties a month, making more money and paying way less tax - but the most important part? Better lifestyle!

title: The Financial Controller
author: The Financial Controller
description:
The Financial Controller, hosted by a CPA and experienced controller, teaches practical accounting, financial analysis, Excel, automation and AI for finance. Episodes cover building financial statements, automating the close, FP&A concepts and the controls that matter in the real world. Built for finance professionals and business owners who want to think like a CFO and grow their careers.

title: Third Generation HVAC
author: terry_roper
description: Third Generation HVAC — real stories and lessons from the gas trade, three generations deep. Host Terry Roper is a third-generation HVAC tech and instructor sharing what the trade taught him: carbon monoxide safety, war stories, and the stuff they don't put in textbooks. New episodes weekly.

title: The Bible Classroom Podcast
author: Reid Ashbaucher
description: Each week, "The Bible Classroom" podcast explores the Bible and its teachings. Jesus proclaimed, “I am the way, the truth, and the life.” Our goal is to clarify the truth revealed through the Scriptures. The Bible offers guidance for life's complexities. Discover a better path found in God's Word with author and Bible teacher Reid Ashbaucher. - Our Email Address: Feedback@rcetc.com - USA

title: The Love Well
author: Meg
description:
Welcome to Love Well 🤍
Love well is a space for real life, raw stories, and the redemptive love of Jesus. Here, we embrace the messy, beautiful, and broken parts of life, inviting Jesus into every chapter, every struggle, and every new beginning. A place where immense love meets abundant grace, shame loses its grip, and truth is spoken with tenderness. No perfect people. No polished stories. Just real life, an ever-present Savior, and the beautiful reminder that grace has the final word. 
Come as you are. Be met with love. Leave changed by grace 💛

title: Voices from the Generals
author: Voices from the Generals
description:
"Voices from the Generals” is a podcast that aims to support the transition to college with episodes featuring specific themes regarding students’ college experiences. Hosted by Washington and Lee University students, the podcast seeks to bring out the real voice and insights of students, faculty, and staff to the audience. The transition to higher education is often experienced as a challenging and uncertain journey, regardless of one’s background or abilities. Whether you are a current undergraduate or a prospective student, we are here to guide you through the journey.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Amazing Howletts Gaming Podcast
author: Amazing Howletts
description: The Amazing Howletts are a father son due who share their views and opinions on video games from across the ages.

title: Lara Lewington's Your Body of Evidence
author: Joy Peddlers
description:
What secrets can your body’s data reveal about your health?

In Your Body of Evidence, technology journalist and broadcaster Lara Lewington explores the science behind health data, wearable technology, at-home testing and the latest wellness claims.

From sleep tracking and personalised nutrition to weight-loss drugs and ageing, each episode asks what the research really shows, which tools and tests are worth using, and how to make sense of the results.

Lara is joined by leading experts to explore how to make more informed decisions about health and support a longer healthspan: more years spent feeling well, active and free from disease.

Produced by Joy Peddlers Studios in partnership with Thriva, Your Body of Evidence is a health podcast that helps listeners cut through the noise and understand what’s worth doing, and what isn’t.

title: And, Tell Me More About That
author: Dr Iain Bolton, Dr Seb Pillon
description:
There’s a lot of health advice out there. How do you know what to believe?
In And, Tell Me More About That, Dr Iain Bolton and Dr Seb Pillon discuss the health stories making headlines, the trends taking over social media and the questions that come up in everyday GP practice.
Drawing on medical evidence and their own experiences, they explore what’s useful, what’s overhyped and what we still don’t know. 
For anyone curious about health, whether you work in medicine or not. New episodes every week.

title: Talk Like A Local: Italian
author: susanchen6
description: Ciao a tutti, and welcome! I’m a Canadian girl with a passion for languages, especially the romance languages. After spending five months living in Naples, in Chiaia, while studying structural engineering, I fell in love with Italy and the Italian language. This podcast is for anyone who wants to learn Italian in a natural, fun, and approachable way through culture, conversation, and everyday expressions. Whether you’re a beginner or already learning, I’m so happy you’re here. Benvenuti!

title: Growing Loud by Children in Scotland
author: Children in Scotland
description:
Growing Loud is the podcast from Children in Scotland exploring the issues shaping childhood today. Hosted by Innes Burns, each episode features conversations with young people, parents, practitioners, campaigners and sector leaders working to improve the lives of children and families across Scotland.
From children's mental health, education and child poverty to youth voice, parenting, public health and children's rights, Growing Loud takes a closer look at the challenges facing young people and the ideas helping them thrive.

title: Katie and Erik | Life After Betrayal
author: Katie and Erik
description:
Infidelity can shatter a marriage, destroy trust, and leave both partners asking questions they never imagined facing. But what does healing actually look like?
Through our personal story of betrayal and recovery, honest conversations about marriage, and insights into faith, counseling, and mental health, we explore why affairs happen, how couples navigate the aftermath, and what it takes to rebuild trust.
Whether you're the betrayed spouse, the partner who was unfaithful, or someone trying to help a couple you love, this podcast offers honest conversations about affair recovery, forgiveness

title: Direction of Travel with Caroline
author: Caroline Bremner
description: Tune in for all the top trends, insights and opinions about the future of travel and tourism

title: Wait, You're Normal? with Sam Cook
author: realsamcook
description: Ever wanted to take a look behind the scenes of the actors you see on your screen or on stage? Or even the people behind the scenes making everything tick? You want to get more of a deep dive into your favorite streamer or content creator? You've found the place! Wait, You're Normal? with Sam Cook is a cozy place for anyone and everyone in the entertainment industry to come and let the weight of their "role" off of their shoulders and just get to chat as them. Truly and authentically. I'm so excited to get to know these people for who they are when their camera turns off.

title: Making An Indie: Dangerous Fruits
author: Dangerous Fruits
description: Writer/director Amanda Holland and producer Ella Mielniczenko talk about making their indie film called Dangerous Fruits and speak with other indie creators to get advice, talk about the state of Hollywood, and what it's like to just make it yourself!

title: Shit Spinners
author: Johnny V and Robbie C
description: Welcome to the Shit Spinners Podcast! We spin some shit in the form of real conversation based on a randomly drawn topic from an actual jar, yes, an actual real-life jar. In a world that is losing the art of conversation, losing the trust in content, a world that is reliant on perfection culture and where people converse based on what’s trending; we want to keep talking downright, down to earth shit. We challenge ourselves with every podcast to never back down from a topic drawn and the best part is: we are just spinning the shit and having fun while doing it. So come have fun with us!

title: Big Brains & Bad Words
author: Professor Profanity
description:
Welcome to Big Brains & Bad Words, where complex nursing concepts meet simple explanations and questionable language.
Hosted by Professor Profanity, a nurse educator with over 20 years of clinical experience, we're making complicated medical concepts make sense through humor, sarcasm, hilarious analogies, and real-world examples.
From pharmacology and pathophysiology to cardiac rhythms and beyond, we're here to help you understand the WHY, not just memorize the WHAT.
Around here, we don't just memorize, we conceptualize. 
Come for the knowledge. Stay for the tasteful profanity.

title: TB or not TB
author: pranay2000
description:
TB, or not TB, that is the question:

Whether 'tis nobler in the mind to suffer

The slings and arrows of outrageous epidemics,

Or to take arms against this vile infection,

And by discovering and discussing, end them.

Pranay and Leo, a clinician and an epidemiologist, pick a paper each episode and discuss what works, what doesn't, and what the models might be missing. Two friends, reading together, thinking out loud, getting smarter in public.

title: Padres Daily | Daily San Diego Padres Podcast
author: Fan Arch
description:
Padres Daily is your daily San Diego Padres podcast for the latest Padres news, trade rumors, game recaps and analysis. Hosted by Beto Diaz, every episode breaks down what’s happening with the Friars: roster moves, free agency, prospects, injury updates, MLB trade deadline buzz and what it all means for San Diego’s playoff chances.

Whether you’re following the NL West race, tracking Padres offseason moves, or just want your daily fix of Padres baseball talk, Padres Daily keeps you up to speed. New episodes every day.

Follow Padres Daily on Spotify and turn on notifications so you never miss an episode.

Practical baselines for jewelry and old gold — not financial advice. Free melt estimate tool: https://mygoldcalc.com

title: A Story for the Anxious
author: Wade Thomas Jr.
description: Jesse Henderson was thinking about killing himself. Then he met a kind barista at a coffee shop that was supposed to be closed. Together, the two of them untangle twin mysteries in their respective pasts, and dig up a decades-old secret buried out in rural West Virginia. Thrilling, funny, and uplifting; like cliff-diving with an old friend. See you at the bottom.

title: Not “Just a Phase”
author: Arthur
description: Welcome people of Indonesia to our podcast Not Just a Phase. We are Arthur and Athena, put the scissors down and sit back down as we talk about depression.

title: The Girl’s Girl Podcast
author: Kateryn Rivera
description:
Welcome to The Girls Girl Podcast — real talk, real sisters, real growth. Hosted by Kateryn Rivera, founder of Girl's Girl Fellowship.
This is your seat at the table for honest conversations about faith, healing, friendship, and becoming the woman God created you to be. Whether you're in your waiting season, your healing era, or just need a sister who gets it — you're home here.
New episodes every month. 🎙️

title: The Moonlit Agent: Real Estate Magic
author: Jessa Clark | The Moonlit Agent
description:
Real estate magic with The Moonlit Agent.
I'm Jessa Clark, a Georgia realtor who plans by the moon and uses intuition, systems, magic, and logic to make it happen.
For many of us, becoming an agent is a spiritual awakening. This is a gentle space for agents to explore rituals, moon-timed planning, and the systems that hold a grounded business together, rooted in Mind, Body, Spirit, and Systems.
New episodes follow the moon.

title: The Staple Podcast
author: Kim Kombat | Kut Sotor
description:
THE STAPLE PODCAST | EPISODE 1
Hosted by Kim Kombat | Co-Host: Kut Sotor
Today's Social Climate — The Reality of People
Has society changed, or are we finally seeing people for who they really are?
In the debut episode of The Staple Podcast, host Kim Kombat and co-host Kut Sotor explore today's social climate and the realities of human behavior.
From loyalty, relationships, and respect to accountability, social media influences, and the way we treat one another, this episode takes a closer look at the issues shaping our everyday lives.

title: Go Now with Dr. Kris Halsey
author: Dr. Kris Halsey
description:
Welcome to Go Now with Dr. Kris Halsey. I am Dr. Halsey, pastor, life coach, and
mental health and wellness practitioner. For years I watched good people postpone
their dreams, waiting for the perfect moment, the perfect time, the perfect sign.
But grief taught me what comfort never could: tomorrow is not promised. On this
podcast we have honest conversations about faith, purpose, and going after the
life you were made for. We will name the dream, face the wait, ask for wisdom,
take the step, and declare it. Not someday, but Today. Subscribe now, and let's 
Go now.

title: Dying of Embarrassment
author: Throne Science
description:
Dying of Embarrassment is a Health & Wellness podcast about the awkward, avoided, and unspoken conversations that quietly shape our health—and sometimes save our lives.

The podcast is hosted by Scott Hickle, Co-Founder and CEO of Throne, and each episode addresses the stuff most of us keep to ourselves—the bodily quirks, the doctor’s-office dread, the “is this normal?” questions you’d never Google on a shared computer. From gut health to grief, from the doctor’s office to the dinner table, we dig into the subjects buried under stigma and treat them like what they are: a normal, important part of being human.

Scott founded Throne to bring passive, clinically meaningful health data into the home, and he started Dying of Embarrassment from the same belief: the conversations we avoid about our bodies, health, and lives are usually the ones that matter most. Because avoiding these conversations almost always costs us more than the embarrassment of having them.

Learn more at http://dyingofembarrassment.com/

title: Alone in NY

description: A solo introvert navigating life, heavy thoughts, and quiet isolation inside the crowded streets of New York City. No small talk, just honest late night reflections.

title: Hey God It’s Me...Talk With God Through Music
author: Kathryn Romanchuk
description:
HEY GOD…IT’S ME;Talk With God Through Music is a Christian podcast for when your heart is FULL, your Faith is being tested, & you can’t quite find the words to pray.

Want to hear the prayer sung and sing it with me? Head over to my YouTube channel and choose the Hey God… It’s Me... Let’s turn the music into a prayer together. https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMwgXeE2jRFk. 💜

What do you say to God when you don’t know what to say? 

Sometimes you’re anxious, exhausted, lonely, angry or afraid, sometimes you’re grieving.. Sometimes you’re incredibly grateful. And sometimes all you can manage is, Hey God…it’s me. Talk to God Through...That’s where the music comes in. 🎶

Each podcast is the prelude to a song, a lyric, a feeling or a real-life moment and turns it into a conversation with God. Together, we’ll use music as a starting point for Prayer, Scripture, reflection and an honest relationship with Jesus—because prayer doesn’t have to sound perfect to be heard.

This isn’t about having all the answers or knowing exactly what to say. It’s about showing up exactly where you are and learning that sometimes the song playing in your head might just help you say what’s already sitting in your heart.

If you’ve ever whispered, cried, sung or simply thought, “God, I need You”… this podcast is for you.

🎧 Press play. Listen to these words. Head over to HEY GOD…IT’S ME Talk With God Through Music. Then talk to God again.

Hey God… It’s ME. 💜

title: The Soft Power Rising
author: Anna
description:
I'm Anna. For most of my life, I was the woman who could do it all. And I took enormous pride in that. 

But somewhere along the way, I'd become so good at being everything everyone needed me to be that I'd forgotten to ask myself what I needed. 

For me, it was motherhood that made that impossible to ignore. And what started as a difficult period in my life ended up making me question everything I'd believed about myself. 

The Soft Power Rising is the story of what happened when I finally decided I was worth showing up for, too. 

I'm still figuring things out. But I'm no longer willing to lose myself in the process.

title: Two Minute Papers
author: Two Minute Papers
description:
Two Minute Papers explains the latest research papers in artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer graphics and simulation in short, accessible episodes. Each episode walks through what a new paper achieves, how it works, and why it matters. What a time to be alive!

Links:
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TwoMinutePapers

title: Walking Feet, Leaping Thoughts
author: K.Kawashima
description:
Kyoto is more than temples and historic streets. Beneath the city lies a landscape shaped by fault lines, ancient rocks, rivers, forgotten roads, place names, and thousands of years of geological and cultural memory.
This podcast begins with walking. Each episode starts from something noticed underfoot—a change in the terrain, an unexpected view, or a place that feels strangely different. From those physical encounters, the journey expands into geology, folklore, history, sociology, and philosophy.
Keywords: Kyoto , Japan , travel , culture , geology , folklore , philosophy

title: Did You Hear What Happened at Work?
author: Stefanie Costi
description:
You know those work horror stories people whisper about in the kitchen?
The ones that start with, “Did YOU hear what happened?” and suddenly everyone stops pretending to make coffee.
Someone checks the door. Someone lowers their voice. And then the room goes quiet because everyone knows it is about to get ugly. 
Well, we’re DONE whispering.
Introducing our brand new podcast, Did You Hear What Happened at Work? 🎙️
We’re bringing you REAL people sharing their experiences of the WILD things people think they can get away with at work.

title: The Overlook
author: Dally Munoz
description: Welcome to The Overlook, the podcast where we dive deep into the world of life simulation games. Join us as we explore the intersection of deep, character-driven gameplay—inspired by the memorable quirks and neighborhood gossip of classic titles—and expansive open worlds. Whether we're dissecting independent projects like SimGoodie, discussing the evolution of building and automation mechanics, or tracking what makes a virtual neighborhood feel truly alive, this is your scenic viewpoint for all things life sims. Pull up a bench, look out over the bay, and join the conversation!

title: Quake's House
author: All Things Comedy
description: Quake’s House is back. Legendary comedian Earthquake brings his signature humor, quick wit, and unfiltered perspective to the table in conversations built around comedy, storytelling, and uncensored opinions. Each week, Quake is joined by friends, fellow comedians, and other guests to joke, roast, debate, and talk about everything from relationships and sports to pop culture, current events, and everyday life. Nothing is off limits, and no one is safe from the punchline.Expect hilarious stories, strong opinions, unexpected debates, and the kind of unfiltered conversations you can only have at Quake’s House. No scripts. No holding back. Just great conversation and even better laughs. Pull up a chair. You’re home.

title: All Things: Word and Spirit
author: @AllThingsWordandSpirit
description: Jesus said that God the Father sent the Holy Spirit to Believers to teach us ALL things! It is by the power of the Holy Spirit and the truth of the Word that we live victorious lives, triumphing over every obstacle.

title: Aggregate Society
author: Andre Woodard and Trevon McGlone
description: Ag Society is a podcast where two fans of the game of football talk about all things Champions League Soccer….probably casually, but still for the love of the game.

title: The Impossible Interview with Sam
author: Sergio AM
description:
History’s legends, back for one more chat.
Each episode, Sam summons a famous figure from the past with a ritual inspired by their life. Inventors, queens, conquerors and rebels correct the myths, share the stories textbooks skip, and imagine “what if” they had made one different choice. Funny, light and grounded in real history.
Sam’s voice is an AI clone of the creator’s own voice; all guest voices are AI-generated, and the interviews are imagined. The history is real; the jokes are not.

title: Inspired by Design with Sarah St Pierre
author: Sarah St Pierre
description: Pour your favorite drink and pull up a seat. This podcast is about real life, becoming who you’re meant to be, and creating a life that actually feels good to live in. We talk about mindset, personal growth, wellness, ambition, and the raw, honest conversations that help you feel clearer, more confident, and more connected to yourself. Some episodes feel like a pep talk. Others feel like a conversation you didn’t know you needed. Through solo episodes and honest conversations with inspiring women, you’ll find encouragement, clarity, perspective, and the reminder that you’re not alone in what you’re navigating. Think of this as a FaceTime call with your big sister. Here to hype you up, ground you, and remind you that you’re allowed to want more and enjoy your life along the way.

title: Belonging in Public Health
author: Faculty of Public Health
description:
Belonging in Public Health is a new podcast series from the UK Faculty of Public Health (FPH), the Royal Society for Public Health (RSPH), the UK Public Health Register (UKPHR) and the London Association of Directors of Public Health (ADPH London). In each episode, a public health professional talks openly about how their identity has shaped their career and what belonging in public health means to them.
The series is hosted by Samia Latif, FPH Board Member and Chair of the Faculty's Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Committee, and Matthew Bazeley-Bell, Deputy Chief Executive of RSPH.

title: Synapse & Scalpel
author: Dina Abou Dargham
description: Step into the intricate intersection of medicine, neuropsychology, and fascinating human history. Hosted by Dina Abou Dargham, Synapse & Scalpel explores the hidden biological mechanisms, brain quirks, and medical mysteries that shape our minds and bodies. Tune in for quick, deep dives into the science of what makes us human.

title: ACMA Medical Affairs x MSL Power Play Series
author: Will Soliman, PhD
description: Leveling up in Medical Affairs or as an MSL? The ACMA Medical Affairs x MSL Power Play Series gives you the insider playbook. ACMA founder Will Soliman sits down with Medical Science Liaisons and pharma leaders from Novo Nordisk, Roche, Lundbeck, and others to share what it really takes to excel and thrive in medical affairs and field medical. description:

Every Thursday on The Economics of It, Cato's Ryan Bourne sits down with leading thinkers to dig into the hidden economics of today's biggest debates, from rent control and tariffs to AI and the cost of war.


Who benefits? Who pays? What happens next? Subscribe and find out.

title: The Irrelevant Leader
author: Phil Jewell | Adam Piercy
description:
What if the best thing you could do as a leader was to make yourself irrelevant?


Not invisible. Not unnecessary. Just no longer the bottleneck.


Join co-hosts Adam Piercy and Phil Jewell, author of The Irrelevant Leader, military veteran, and executive leadership coach, for honest, thought-provoking conversations about what it really takes to lead people well.


Adam asks the questions, challenges the thinking, and draws out the stories and lessons from Phil's experiences in the military, business, and beyond.


Together, they explore the behaviours that hold leaders and their teams back, challenging conventional thinking around trust, delegation, decision-making, accountability, and letting go of control.


Expect candid conversations, practical insights, and a different perspective on what great leadership actually looks like.


Because great leadership isn't about being at the centre of everything. It's about building a team that succeeds without you having to be.

Each episode explores ancient wisdom and practical spiritual principles that can help you understand your energy, strengthen your consciousness, and intentionally create the life you desire.
We explore the Law of Attraction, universal laws, fasting and cleansing, meditation, manifestation, discipline, relationships, nature, ancestral wisdom, abundance, and the deeper connection between your inner world and the reality you experience. Tap in!

Karen breaks business down into practical, bite-sized ideas you can put into action, without the pressure to hustle harder, grow a team or build someone else's version of success.


Expect practical advice and real conversations about money, marketing, customers, boundaries, confidence and what it takes to run a small business alongside relationships, family and life.

title: The Real Intelligence Podcast
author: Gary Kadi
description:
If your business stops the moment you step away, this show is for you.
The Real Intelligence Podcast is about how we work and live in the new AI world, hosted by Gary Kadi and Gus Waite. It is for business owners and C-suite executives who are ready to stop being the bottleneck in their own business.
Season one, Inside Man, asked what success was costing the man behind it. Season two goes outside and asks the harder question: how do you redesign a business so that success no longer requires the owner, the team or the family to suffer?
Gary and Gus build the answer in public. Every episode is what they are actually installing, inside delegAIte and inside the businesses they work with. What worked, what did not, and what it cost to find out. Real systems, real stories, no theory.
Gary Kadi has spent more than 30 years coaching business owners and has worked with more than 6,000 businesses. He founded NextLevel Practice, created the category of Complete Health Dentistry, and built and sold his own company in a triple-win exit.
Gus Waite is Chief of AI Innovation and Integration at delegAIte, and runs delegAIte itself as the proof: an agentic company with no employees, where everything that repeats is handled by systems and the people do only what they love.
What we cover: agentic AI inside a real business, the Eight Divisions, scaling without adding headcount, getting the owner out of the operating seat, what to automate first and what to leave alone, and the beliefs that have to move before any of it works.
Recent conversations include building the first FDA-cleared skin cancer scanner for family doctors, and what it takes to run a five million dollar company with no employees at all.
Book a call: delegaite.co
Nobody gets replaced. Everybody gets elevated.

title: The Prince of India (Why Constantinople Fell)
author: Lew Wallace
description:
The Wandering Shoemaker, a figure cursed to roam the earth until the Second Coming, witnesses the rise and fall of empires in Lew Wallace's captivating novel, *The Prince of India; or Why Constantinople Fell*. Journey through history as this intriguing character navigates the complexities of faith, power, and redemption across centuries. From the crucifixion of Jesus to the pivotal moments leading to the fall of Constantinople, each chapter reveals layers of conflict that challenge his understanding of humanity and divine purpose.

As he encounters historical figures and witnesses monumental events, the shoemaker wrestles with his own identity and the weight of his curse. Is he merely a spectator, or does his existence hold the key to a greater truth? The intertwining of legend and history creates a rich tapestry that explores themes of sacrifice, love, and the eternal struggle between good and evil.

Listeners will be drawn into a world where every choice has consequences, and the paths of destiny collide in unexpected ways. With each twist and turn, *The Prince of India* invites you to ponder the profound questions of life and faith while keeping you on the edge of your seat. Don't miss this opportunity to experience a unique blend of folklore and historical fiction that redefines the boundaries of storytelling.

Two brothers. One podcast. Several thousand miles apart.
Mike's in the UK. Chris is heading to Ghana for four years, so rather than relying entirely on WhatsApp to keep up with each other's lives, we've decided to record our conversations instead.

title: Bull City Beats
author: City of Durham NC
description:
Bull City Beats is the official podcast of the Durham Police Department, designed to take listeners beyond the badge and introduce them to the people, stories, and experiences that shape the department and the Durham community.

Hosted by Dwight Bell, the 12-episode series explores the human side of policing through candid conversations with sworn officers, professional staff, department leadership, and others who contribute to public safety.

Developed in partnership with the U.S. Department of Justice’s Office of Community Oriented Policing Services (COPS Office), the podcast answers questions about policing, explores the diverse roles within the department, highlights career journeys and personal experiences, and shares stories that may otherwise go untold.

At its heart, Bull City Beats is about connection, transparency, and community—offering listeners a deeper understanding of the people behind the badge and the shared commitment to serving Durham.

title: Hot Mess Magic
author: Michelle Burke
description:
You became someone to survive.
To belong. To be loved. To keep the peace, keep it together, keep going.
It worked,  you’re here.
But the identity you built to get through your life started running it.
Hot Mess Magic is the conversation about the gap.
Each week Michelle Burke sits with people willing to say the true thing out loud.
Not the curated version. What’s underneath.
The patterns mistaken for personality.
The stories inherited before you could choose.
The roles played so long they stopped feeling like roles.
These are the conversations that usually stay private, about who you became, who you actually are, and the moment you realize the two no longer match.
No steps. No homework. No one here to fix you.
You were never broken.
Just the clean cut of finally hearing it named.
New episodes every Friday.

Join Brian Lowell for honest conversations with gardeners, homesteaders, and others who share a passion for growing. Brian and his guests talk about their lives, how they got into gardening, and the lessons they’ve learned through successes, mistakes, and everyday experience.


Along the way, they share how gardening has helped them improve their physical and mental health, build relationships, and find more enjoyment in daily life. Whether you’re just getting started or have been gardening for years, you’ll hear familiar experiences, fresh perspectives, and stories from people who love getting their hands in the soil.

author: Podcast WABCRadio
description:
Join Bill Newstad, attorney and partner at Rampulla & Newstad, for What’s in Your Wagon?, a podcast dedicated to estate planning, elder law, and protecting the assets you’ve worked a lifetime to build.

Bill breaks down how to safeguard your wealth from predators and creditors, navigate Medicaid eligibility, and ensure your assets are passed on according to your wishes. Discover how the right estate planning strategies, including irrevocable trusts, may help you protect what matters most while maintaining control over your assets.

Whether you’re planning for your own future or helping a loved one prepare for the years ahead, What’s in Your Wagon? offers valuable insights to help you make informed decisions and protect your legacy.

Tune in and find out how to protect what you’ve earned, preserve your choices, and keep your future on track.

News and Information for those on the go in Halton Hills, Ontario

title: The Postpartum Voice
author: Ashley Graham
description:
Welcome to The Postpartum Voice, a space dedicated to honest conversations about postpartum, motherhood, identity, and voice. Motherhood doesn't simply change your life. It changes you. And for one of the most profound transformations a person can experience, far too many mothers are left searching for language, support, and understanding along the way.
Join your host, Ashley Graham, as she explores the realities of life after birth, inviting mothers, advocates, experts, and thought leaders into conversations that challenge outdated narratives and create space for a more honest and empowered maternal experience.
In this podcast, you'll dive into postpartum life, maternal advocacy, self-trust, identity shifts, personal growth, and the journey of reclaiming your voice in motherhood. Ashley takes listeners beyond the highlight reel and into the nuanced conversations that help mothers feel seen, understood, and more deeply connected to themselves.
Whether you're navigating the early days of postpartum, redefining who you are as a mother, or seeking a deeper understanding of the transformation motherhood brings, The Postpartum Voice is here to remind you that your experience matters, your story matters, and your voice deserves to be heard.
Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or Spotify and join the conversation at simplyashleygraham.com as we create better support, better stories, better language, and better care for mothers everywhere.
Because every transformation deserves a voice.

title: One More Chapter
author: Walter Linden
description:
Every child knows the words: “Just one more chapter!” Now there’s always one waiting.


One More Chapter brings the great classic children’s books to life, one chapter at a time.

Calm, unhurried read-alouds made for bedtime, quiet afternoons and long car rides.


Narrated using AI voice technology.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Big AI Debate
author: The AI Summit Series
description:
AI experts go head-to-head on AGI, regulation, jobs and ethics, and you vote on who wins. 🎙️
THE BIG AI Debate is the AI podcast where the sharpest minds in artificial intelligence argue the side they don't believe. Every episode, two guests take on the AI question everyone's already debating: AGI timelines, AI regulation, the future of work, AI ethics, and the next big breakthrough.
No scripts. No consensus. You decide who wins.
🗳️ Vote on every episode on our social feeds.
🎧 Follow so you never miss a debate.
Brought to you by The AI Summit Series, the world's premier AI conference.

title: Olde Stories, New Voices
author: South Carolina’s Olde English District
description: Olde Stories, New Voices is a new podcast series from South Carolina’s Olde English District (OED) and hosted by Micah Decker, exploring the region’s role in the American Revolution. Each episode walks a different chapter of the district’s new Backcountry Revolution Trail, a sestercentennial experience connecting battlefields, museums and landmarks across seven counties in north central South Carolina. To learn more about the Backcountry Revolution Trail, visit backcountryrevolutiontrail.com.

title: While we're Alive
author: Frédérique Thiébaut
description:
Because your life is happening now.
Conversations for people who refuse to sleepwalk through life.
While we’re Alive, hosted by Frédérique Thiébaut, explores what it means to live a life that is genuinely yours. Through honest conversations about love, ambition, desire, success, failure, purpose, pleasure, ageing, loss and death, we explore what makes life meaningful, what we learn the hard way, and what really matters.
Not about having the perfect life, but being awake to the one you have. Because one day, there will be no more time. But today, there is.

title: Sermon Tools
author: Sermon Tools
description: A daily show for pastors and church media teams, about what happens to a sermon after the amen: the recording, the clips, the transcript, the small-group guide, the Monday after. Every episode takes one narrow, practical problem and walks through how to do it this week. Try the free tools behind the show: Sermon Clips gives you 2 free sermons, no card, at sermon-clips.com — your sermon becomes captioned clips and a Sermon Packet. Sermon Transcription gives your first sermon free, no card, at sermon-transcription.com — transcript, notes, devotional, quotes and discussion questions from one upload.

title: Studs or Moulds
author: Ryan
description:
Studs or Moulds is a football podcast that dives into the stories behind the players, managers, and personalities who have experienced the highs and lows of the beautiful game.


Hosted with a relaxed, honest, and often humorous approach, each episode explores the journeys of guests from grassroots and Sunday League football all the way to the professional game. We uncover career-defining moments, dressing-room tales, promotion battles, cup runs, setbacks, and the lessons learned along the way.


Whether you're a die-hard football fan, a non-league supporter, or someone who loves hearing real stories from the people who lived them, Studs or Moulds brings you authentic conversations and unique insights from across the football world.


From Sunday League pitches to packed stadiums, every guest has a story to tell.

⚽ Real stories. Real characters. One question... Stud or Mould? 🎙️

title: Please, Health Me!?
author: Woven Logic Studio
description:
Healthcare is confusing. Sometimes even after an appointment, you’re left wondering: What did that actually mean? What should I ask next? And what am I supposed to do with all of this?

Please, Health Me!? brings two perspectives to the same confusing healthcare moment: a board certified family nurse practitioner with more than 45 years of healthcare experience and her daughter, a Creative Technologist and designer who specializes in making complicated things easier to understand.

Together, this mother-daughter team digs into the real health questions people are asking, from symptoms, screenings, medications, and medical testing to insurance, finding care, and navigating a healthcare system that doesn’t always make things easy.

Expect candid conversations, practical explanations, the questions you may not know to ask, and plenty of “wait, what does that actually mean?” moments. And when a conversation calls for more than an explanation, we turn it into something useful, with checklists, guides, questions to bring to your provider, and resources you can take with you.

Because understanding your healthcare shouldn’t require a medical degree.

title: Mr Peters' Handy Dandy NCLEX-PN Review

The Little Podcast That Helps You Pass the Big Test!

title: Let's Eat!
author: Billy Hennessey
description:
Let’s Eat! serves up Macon’s food scene with plenty of flavor, personality, and laughs. Host Billy Hennessey—a longtime Delta flight attendant, world traveler, food columnist, and outspoken champion of Macon’s surprisingly diverse cuisine—sits down with the restaurateurs, chefs, servers, bartenders, and fellow food lovers who keep the city hungry for more. From local favorites and hidden gems to restaurant news, lively opinions and the stories behind the menus, each episode celebrates the people and places shaping how Macon eats. Come hungry—and expect a few laughs along the way.

Let’s Eat! is co-presented by Creek Media and The Macon Telegraph, connecting Billy’s regular food column with even more delicious conversations.  WARNING: Listening on an empty stomach may result in sudden cravings, impulsive reservations and an uncontrollable urge to say, “Let’s eat!” 😉

description: Two best friends. 22 years. One recorder finally hit. Sammy Panice (Panicci Ventures) and Jayme Rose Gray (Launch Your Light) dig into the future of business, AI, robots, and what it means to stay human when the machines take the grunt work. Real systems, real numbers, zero corporate fluff: how to automate the busywork, get found on Google and in AI search, and build the business you actually want. A 10-part series, new episodes weekly. title: Crime Junkie
author: GFTR
description: Does hearing about a true crime case always leave you scouring the internet for the truth behind the story? Dive into your next mystery with Crime Junkie. Every Monday, join your host Ashley Flowers as she unravels all the details of infamous and underreported true crime cases with her best friend Brit Prawat. From cold cases to missing persons and heroes in our community who seek justice, Crime Junkie is your destination for theories and stories you won’t hear anywhere else.   Whether you're a seasoned true crime enthusiast or new to the genre, you'll find yourself on the edge of your seat awaiting a new episode every Monday.  If you can never get enough true crime... Joel’s Unfiltered is a podcast dedicated to personal growth, meaningful conversations, and real-life transformation.
Each episode brings together inspiring guests—from professionals and everyday people to individuals with compelling stories to explore lessons on self-improvement, success, mindset, relationships, health, and living a purposeful life.
Looking for inspiring advice, honest perspectives, and meaningful conversations about life’s challenges.

title: Winning the Battle for Heart & Connection

Welcome to the Winning the Battle for Heart & Connection podcast, where we dive

edge insights into emotional resilience, neuroscience, and parenting, and timeless
principles about transformation and connection, this podcast is dedicated to helping
families win the battles that matter most.
Each episode brings meaningful insights, expert interviews, practical tools, and real-life
stories to help parents and grandparents connect with their kids and break unhealthy
generational patterns. Together, we explore the beauty and confidence found in
personal transformation and emotional regulation—learning how healing and repair can
interrupt harmful cycles and create healthy patterns, and how connection becomes the
foundation for lasting influence.

title: Time on Wing (RTX)

description: Time on wing is the hours an engine runs between removals; it is the number RTX’s whole repair is built to lift, and the one its airline customers are measured against. Time on Wing reads the company the same way: what management declared, what the record shows, and the tests written down before each print so they can be scored after it. Three segments in three phases, the geared-turbofan fleet and the money owed on it, a defense backlog booked under ceilings, the one critical audit matter that carries it, and the policy clocks running through all of them. One company, one quarter at a time, from the public record only.

Join @ManFromTheStars1111 & @ImmortalNegus as we explore spirituality, ancient wisdom, energy, healing, self-discovery, relationships, purpose, and the power of the mind. title: Retirement: Reimagined
author: Matthew Walne
description:
Hosted by Matthew Walne, tis podcast provides the clarity, knowledge and skills you need to build your dream retirement. 
Whether you're in your 30's and simply considering your options or you're on the cusp of retirement yourself, this podcast will help you navigate some of the trickiest questions the arise when planning your retirement. 
Each of us has a different story, a different life experience and your retirement should be some of the best years of your life.
My dad sold his business and retired with the intention to travel and enjoy life, unfortunately he fell seriously ill and passed away shortly after retiring. He wasn't able to enjoy the next chapter of his life, I've learned that we should enjoy what we have whilst we're able to. Responsibly of course.
You shouldn't feel guilty for wanting to help your children or treat yourself to the holiday you've dreamed of since you were little. There are plans and structures we can put in place to ensure you're able to spend without the worry or anxiety of running out of money.
Whether you're worried about losing that regular pay check or losing your identity after leaving the role that's given you purpose for years, this podcast will guide you through what you can do to make sure your retirement is the next chapter, not the end.
It's also important to realise, that it's not just about the money. There's more to retirement than just the numbers. It's about your social circle, your mental health, your relationships and hobbies. There's so much people don't consider when it actually comes to retiring. 
This podcast aims to change that.

title: Making Change Stick: The Art and Science of School Improvement
author: Dr James Mannion
description: What proportion of school change initiatives actually improve outcomes in a lasting way? The answer is shockingly low – and it’s not for want of trying. In Making Change Stick: The Art and Science of School Improvement, Dr James Mannion – former teacher, school leader and Cambridge researcher – combines research-informed implementation know-how with the lived experience of educators leading change in schools. Expect practical tools, honest reflections (warts and all!) and inspiring stories from teachers and school leaders. For anyone who wants their next initiative to work – and then to stick!

title: Better Bridge Podcast
author: Christopher Warren
description:
The Better Bridge Podcast is where money, business and technology meet community. Host Chris Warren sits down with small business owners, nonprofit leaders, and builders doing it the hard way to talk honestly about what it really takes to build a better tomorrow.

Every episode is built on one of Better Bridge’s four pillars:


Empowerment: practical, judgment-free personal finance, from budgeting on an unpredictable income to staying out of debt.


Community: the people and organizations lifting their neighbors up.


Creation: starting, growing, and sustaining a small business, told by the founders living it.

Optimism: how AI and new technology can be good for everyone, not just big companies.


Real conversations and free, practical lessons you can use right away, whether you’re stuck in an hourly job dreaming of something of your own or already running a business.


Better Bridge is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit offering free personal finance education, small business support, and technology built for communities. Find free resources at https://www.betterbridge.org

title: Understanding Blood Alcohol Levels: How Alcohol Affects Your Body
author: Promille Kalkulator
description:
How does alcohol affect your blood alcohol concentration, reaction time, and judgment? In this episode, we explain the basics of BAC, the factors that influence alcohol absorption, and why estimating your alcohol level is not the same as knowing whether you are safe to drive.
Explore the topic with [Promillekalkulator.com](https://promillekalkulator.com/), an online blood alcohol calculator designed according to Norway , Germany, Sweden, Finland, Poland, Denmark and France limits. You understand estimated alcohol levels. Remember: estimates are not guarantees of sobriety or fitness to drive.

title: Black Girl Margins-Notes on Power, Beauty, and Becoming
author: Black Girl Margins
description:
Black Girl Margins is an editorial audio series exploring the psychology of modern womanhood through the lens of Black women's experiences. From beauty, relationships, and self-worth to power, boundaries, identity, and the pressure to have it all together, each episode examines the hidden patterns behind everyday life. Through thought-provoking storytelling, cultural commentary, and fresh perspectives, we unpack the things women experience but rarely discuss.
Black Girl Margins. Notes on power, beauty, and becoming.

title: Why Does My Body Do That?
author: Podlatino
description:
Why does your heart race when you’re scared? Why do you get a fever, shaky hands, goosebumps, or butterflies in your stomach? What is actually happening inside your body when you sleep, eat, run, fall in love, or feel pain?
Why Does My Body Do That? explores the biology and medicine hiding behind everyday human experiences. Each episode begins with one simple question and travels inside the body to discover what your organs, nerves, hormones, cells, and immune system are doing while you go about your day.
No boring lectures, impossible medical jargon, or previous knowledge required. Just fascinating science explained through clear ideas, vivid examples, surprising connections, and stories anyone can understand.
Made for curious adults, teenagers, and younger listeners who want to understand the extraordinary machine they have been living inside their entire lives.
Your body does some pretty weird things. Usually, there’s a very good reason why.

title: Halloween
author: Tinker Bell Ripa
description: Hola !! En éste episodio hoy tendremos una importante novedad para el cuidado de nuestra piel. Chicas, ustedes saben bien que todas tenemos un tipo de rostro particular en lo que respecta a nuestra piel en común. Por ejemplo, tenemos la piel grasa, la piel sensible, la piel porosa o piel de naranja, tenemos acné, entre otros tantos casos documentados de perfecciones e imperfecciones que nos caracterizan. Por eso aquí compartiré unos tips hacerca del cuidado de nuestra piel. En primer lugar cuando vamos a maquillarnos si vamos a usar una base de maquillaje, aseguremosno de aplicarla sin frotar ni refregar y con unas pausas, porque tomarte tu tiempo para tu rutina de skincare, siempre está muy bien para todas. Por otro lado el maquillaje. La calma y la suavidad en la aplicación, con el tiempo hará cosas muy buenas a nuestro favor. Los exfoliantes debemos usarlos con suavidad, ya que están pensado para hacer el trabajo que haremos con ellos y no necesitan que hagamos cosas como hacer presión o aplicar rapidez en su aplicación. Respetando esto, con el tiempo nuestra piel se verá muy bien y sin signos de daños además de verse muy suave y juvenil. En el caso de las cremas creo que sería mejor si durante la aplicación hacemos un poco de presion. Ésto puede mejorar la absorción de nuestra piel y darnos un buen acabado de precision. Por otro lado cuando nos hagamos el color del cabello, podríamos hacerlo sin repeticiones en la misma zona dónde ya hemos pasado, para reducir los daños de realizarse una coloración, en el caso de si usamos una colorante de fórmula tradicional. Sin embargo aseguremosno que el cabello quede bien cubierto con la tintura del colorante. Y tomemosno un descanso antes de volvernos a teñir el cabello, nuestro cuero cabello nos lo va a agradecer. Y por último nunca se olviden de que todos los cosméticos en general son de origen químico y tienen ciertos efectos invasivos en nuestra piel. Antes de comenzar con todo lo mencionado es fundamental tener cuidado con la preparación de nuestra piel, en lo posible evitando usar agua demaciado fria. Gracias por la atención que estén muy bien, divinas!!

title: Psychology of a Serial Killer | True Crime, Forensic Psychology, Criminal Profiles
author: Jonah White & Jaxon Foss | Criminology and Mental Health Major
description: Have you ever wondered if the warning signs of a serial killer were there all along? Are you looking for true crime content that doesn’t just retell the story, but also dives into the psychology behind it? Psychology of a Serial Killer is the weekly podcast that dives deep into the minds of killers and the reasons behind their behavior. Hosted by Jaxon Foss and Jonah White, we explore factors such as childhood trauma, abuse, personality disorders, fantasies, obsessions, and their need for power and control. Whether you’re a true crime enthusiast or just a casual listener, this podcast is here to show you what TRULY goes on in their twisted minds. As hosts with backgrounds in both criminology and mental health, we have spent our education researching exactly what this show explores. Each episode is researched thoroughly in order to provide the most accurate representation of case history and psychological state. Through digging into the case files behind these crimes, we discovered that understanding a killer’s psychology isn’t about excusing what they’ve done. Instead, it is about learning to recognize and identify the warning signs before they escalate. Now, we want to share with you the specific disorders that can be connected to specific killers, episode by episode. If you’re looking to actually understand what the warning signs of serious psychological issues look like, Psychology of a Serial Killer is where you’ll find extensive research that is grounded in real psychology and paired with a serial murder case. Join us as we dive into the mind of John Wayne Gacy and his struggle with Antisocial Personality Disorder, David Berkowitz and Schizophrenia, Jeffrey Dahmer and Borderline Personality Disorder, and many more. So, if you’re ready to understand the mind of a murderer, tune into Psychology of a Serial Killer, available wherever you get your podcasts. Don’t miss an episode of the true crime podcast that treats the psychology as seriously as the story.

title: From The Boys
author: MDX Studios
description:
What is it to be a boy in London in 2026?

There is a lot of talk in the media about the problem of boys, but the conversation too often doesn’t include us or reflect our experiences. In this podcast we set the agenda and talk about the things that really matter to us, to share our experiences from our own perspectives.


We are year 10 boys from William Ellis School in north London. For our podcast series From the Boys, we have set out to voice our perspectives in this changing world of societal pressures and expectations on boys. We are aware there are many discussions around boyhood, however we want to involve boys of our age in these discussions to truly show how we feel and what we experience. In each episode, we talk to a range of people from educational specialists, teachers, young men and boys with different and important viewpoints.


This podcast is for boys and those who are interested in their experiences.

We hope that this podcast spreads awareness of the issues boys are actually facing.

We hope that this podcast breaks the stereotypes of boys.

We hope that this podcast raises awareness of some of the issues boys face and some of the misconceptions about them.

We hope this podcast gives boys a chance to have their voices heard.

From the Boys is an MDX Studios Production, copyright 2026.


This podcast was created by Ahmed, Kente, Daniel, Jacob, Bobby, Patrick, Isaaq, Oskar, Muhamed, Tyrese, Ethan, Guillem, Kobi, Rabah, Arda and Félix from William Ellis School, in the London Borough of Camden.

description:

Whether you’re a mom, love a mom, or support moms in your work, you belong here. Because asking “Is MOM ok?” is only the beginning.

At the heart of this gathering is a simple but urgent question: what does it mean to respond faithfully and courageously in this time? As familiar models are being reshaped, Synergy 7 creates space to explore how the Church can rediscover its missionary edge through the full expression of fivefold leadership—apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers working together to equip God’s people.


The future of the Church will be discovered by seeking God’s heart and rediscovering the fullness of His Spirit. 

Discover with us.

title: Real Thoughts, Simple Joys: For Teens | Joy, overthinking, transitions, stress, worries, skills, peace, changes, growing up, overwhelmed
author: Bria Bauer
description:
Have you ever felt trapped in your own thoughts, struggling to notice the bright spots around you? Welcome to Real Thoughts, Simple Joys—a weekly show dedicated to embracing small everyday moments, even when we don’t have all the answers. 
As a college student, I constantly navigate ups, downs, changes, and endless overthinking that defined my teenage years, so I truly understand where you’re coming from. Growing up taught me just how much goodness we miss when we forget to pause and appreciate it. That’s why I’m here to share my personal journey and insights with you. 
If you need a welcoming space free from daily worries where you feel genuinely understood, this podcast is for you. If you’re ready to feel a little more light, tune in to Real Thoughts, Simple Joys!

title: Room Tone
author: Hailes
description: Welcome to Room Tone— an intimate conversation series hosted by singer/songwriter & curator Hailes, exploring the lives, creative processes, and stories behind the art. An extension of Living Room by Hailes, a Kansas City live music residency produced in collaboration with NOMADA at In The Lowest Ferns, Rom Tone carries the spirit of the residency beyond the stage. Through candid conversations with artists, we explore creativity, identity, ambition, vulnerability, and the experiences that shape the work. Room Tone is where the conversation continues after the music stops.

description:

title: Xcel - A Mental Evolution Podcast with Dr. Seth Rose

description:
Xcel - A Mental Evolution Podcast with Dr. Seth Rose discusses all things mental performance, and performance excellence, and aims to understand the emotional and behavioral underpinnings of human performance. Each short episode strives to provide tangible, impactful, and evidence-based principles and strategies to enhance your performance when it matters most - whether in your sport, job, performance, or life.

Dr. Seth Rose is an experienced and professional Certified Mental Performance Consultant (CMPC®) and Ph.D. in Sport and Performance Psychology with a strong background in higher education and mental performance consulting with elite performers. He is passionate about unlocking human excellence and training individuals to enhance and sustain performance, health, and well-being. He incorporates mental skills training, performance enhancement techniques, and cognitive skills development with various populations such as the military, athletes, and coaches at every level.
